summary: The dump depth coverage obligation is introduced. The old do_dump had no depth check; the new check is the innermost condition the fixed harness cannot satisfy.

coverage_evidence.dependency_reason: The complete fixed entry shows how dump objects are obtained and passed to both dump modes.

claims.necessity_reason: The reviewed target coverage obligation is frozen as established.

before.requirement: Exercise the same deep-object dump condition; the depth-check behavior does not yet exist.
before.reason: The complete old do_dump body recurses into nested arrays but has no depth guard to execute.

source_evidence.dependency_reason: The unchanged parser limited the objects the harness could supply before the change.

after.requirement: Exercise do_dump's new return path when depth reaches JSON_PARSER_MAX_DEPTH.
after.reason: The new depth condition cannot become true for an object accepted by the unchanged parser and passed through this entry.

source_evidence.dependency_reason: The parser rejects values beyond its depth limit.
Dump traversal starts at depth zero.

claims.comparison_reason: The parser's limit and the harness's load-only setup are unchanged. For this exact coverage obligation, the innermost unsatisfied condition is the depth guard added to do_dump; it had no counterpart before the change.
